hard: The only production mutation surface is scope.modify. If RA-5 requires changing any existing RA-1/RA-2/RA-3/RA-4/core provider/lifecycle file, fail closed back to Brain.

RA-5 imports from RA-1/RA-2/RA-3/RA-4 only through public exported APIs. No import of names beginning with "_" from research_contract.py, source_acquisition.py, research_record.py or research_protocol.py is permitted. Any RA-5-specific strict JSON/Unicode/bounds helpers live in the new RA-5 modules.

The research-provider protocol is pure and caller-supplied. It performs no provider, filesystem, repository, environment, network, connector, subprocess or clock I/O. It is a separate protocol family and does not call the existing BrainProvider or ReviewerProvider invocation surfaces.

Expose pure construction/revalidation for AIOS_RESEARCH_PROVIDER_REQUEST v1 and AIOS_RESEARCH_PROVIDER_RETURN v1. Both are transient cognitive-support artifacts, never lifecycle state or mutation authority.

AIOS_RESEARCH_PROVIDER_REQUEST v1 contains exactly: format, version, kind, request_mode, research_brief, audit_profile, predecessor_record, baseline_acquisitions, stage1_lineage, evidence_construct, counter_acquisitions, request_fingerprint. format/version/kind are exactly AIOS_RESEARCH_PROVIDER_REQUEST / 1 / RESEARCH_PROVIDER_REQUEST.

request_mode is exactly EVIDENCE_CONSTRUCT or AUDIT_RECONCILE. research_brief is one exact valid AIOS_RESEARCH_BRIEF v1. audit_profile is one exact normalized research-high-value-v1 profile. predecessor_record is null or one exact valid AIOS_RESEARCH_RECORD v1 under the same Brief/profile.

baseline_acquisitions is an order-insensitive non-empty list of exact {request, attempt} pairs. Every request is BASELINE, every attempt is exact same-request SUCCEEDED, and the list satisfies the Brief baseline-request bound. Provider request construction must revalidate these through public RA-1/RA-2 APIs.
EVIDENCE_CONSTRUCT requires stage1_lineage=null, evidence_construct=null and counter_acquisitions=[].

AUDIT_RECONCILE requires one exact Stage-1 lineage mapping containing exactly stage1_request_fingerprint, stage1_return_fingerprint and construct_fingerprint, one exact validated RA-4 Evidence Construct, and an exact non-empty successful counter-acquisition pair for every precommitted counter request.

Building an AUDIT_RECONCILE request requires the exact previously validated Stage-1 provider request and Stage-1 provider return as caller inputs. It must prove identical Research Brief, audit profile, predecessor_record and baseline_acquisitions semantic basis; the Stage-1 return semantic_value must be exactly the supplied Evidence Construct. Any substitution fails closed.

Provider request fingerprint is SHA-256 over canonical strict JSON of the normalized request excluding only request_fingerprint. Provider/model/session/endpoint/host/ invocation/credential/usage/latency/native transport metadata is absent from the request and cannot affect this identity. Request normalized size is <=16777216 UTF-8 JSON bytes and structural depth <=32.

Provider-native response is admitted only as one strict closed semantic body bound by exact request_fingerprint. It contains no provider/model/session/endpoint/host/ invocation/credential/usage/latency/raw response/native log/chain-of-thought or nested provider-protocol envelope.

For EVIDENCE_CONSTRUCT, the admitted raw response contains exactly request_fingerprint, claims, challenge_targets, counter_evidence_requests. Deterministic RA-5 support injects the exact request Research Brief/profile/baseline material and calls public RA-4 construct_research_evidence_construct. The provider never supplies construct_fingerprint, baseline acquisition summaries or derived RA-4 identity.

For AUDIT_RECONCILE, the admitted raw response contains exactly request_fingerprint, audit_results, claim_reconciliation, new_claim_fingerprints, research_record, outcome. Deterministic RA-5 support injects the exact request Evidence Construct/profile/baseline/counter/predecessor material and calls public RA-4 construct_research_reconciliation. The provider never supplies reconciliation_fingerprint or counter acquisition summaries.

AIOS_RESEARCH_PROVIDER_RETURN v1 contains exactly: format, version, kind, request_mode, request_fingerprint, semantic_value, return_fingerprint. semantic_value is exactly the deterministic RA-4 Evidence Construct for EVIDENCE_CONSTRUCT or exact deterministic RA-4 Research Reconciliation for AUDIT_RECONCILE.

return_fingerprint is SHA-256 over canonical strict JSON of the normalized provider return excluding only return_fingerprint. The same valid semantic response to the same provider request yields the same return identity regardless of provider/model/ session transport. Provider return normalized size is <=4194304 UTF-8 JSON bytes and structural depth <=32.

Provider response/request validation failure is a research-provider protocol error only. It does not create RESEARCH_CANDIDATE, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, RUN, RESULT, FAILURE, REVIEW, remediation, retry/fallback or publication state.

Expose pure normalization/reference functions for AIOS_ACQUISITION_ADAPTER_MANIFEST v1. The manifest contains exactly: format, version, kind, adapter_id, adapter_version, transport_class, source_families, access_scopes, manifest_fingerprint. format/version/kind are exactly AIOS_ACQUISITION_ADAPTER_MANIFEST / 1 / ACQUISITION_ADAPTER_MANIFEST.

transport_class is exactly PUBLIC_HTTP, PUBLIC_SEARCH, REPOSITORY_READ or AUTHORIZED_CONNECTOR. source_families and access_scopes are unique non-empty order-insensitive closed lists. Manifest id/version are bounded safe text and contain no credentials, machine-local paths, native logs or session material.

Transport/source-family grammar is closed: PUBLIC_HTTP and PUBLIC_SEARCH support only OFFICIAL_DOCS, SPECIFICATION, PAPER_REPORT or PUBLIC_WEB and only PUBLIC access; REPOSITORY_READ supports exactly REPOSITORY and may support PUBLIC and/or AUTHORIZED_PRIVATE; AUTHORIZED_CONNECTOR supports exactly CONNECTED_SOURCE and only AUTHORIZED_PRIVATE. The manifest describes capability only and never grants access.

Expose construction/revalidation for AIOS_ACQUISITION_ADAPTER_INVOCATION v1 with exactly: format, version, kind, research_brief, acquisition_request, challenge_targets, adapter_ref, access_mode, authorization_context_ref, invocation_id, invocation_fingerprint. adapter_ref contains exactly adapter_id, adapter_version, manifest_fingerprint.

The invocation revalidates the exact Brief, Acquisition Request and Challenge Targets through public RA-1 APIs; request.source_family must be supported by the explicit supplied manifest and access_mode must be supported by the manifest. No source-family or locator heuristic may choose an adapter.

authorization_context_ref is null for PUBLIC and is required for AUTHORIZED_PRIVATE. It is opaque bounded non-secret non-machine-local text supplied only as a reference to access already authorized outside RA-5. It never enters Source Observation, Research Record or Brain provider semantic material.

PUBLIC_HTTP requires access_mode PUBLIC and request.locator_or_query to be one credential-free http/https URL acceptable to the public-destination guard before the adapter is called. PUBLIC_SEARCH requires PUBLIC and does not fetch result URLs. AUTHORIZED_CONNECTOR requires AUTHORIZED_PRIVATE. REPOSITORY_READ may use either access mode but still forbids machine-local filesystem locator material.

invocation_fingerprint is SHA-256 over canonical strict JSON of normalized invocation excluding only invocation_fingerprint. Invocation normalized size is <=131072 UTF-8 JSON bytes and structural depth <=24.

Expose one thin explicit invoke_acquisition_adapter boundary receiving exactly one normalized invocation, its exact manifest and one caller-selected adapter callable. It calls that callable exactly once and never discovers/selects another adapter, retries, paginates, query-expands, fetches follow-up search hits, falls back or fails over.

For PUBLIC_HTTP the boundary supplies a destination-guard callback to the adapter. Before each network connection and each redirect, a conforming adapter must call the guard with the candidate URL and its resolved IP literals. The guard accepts only credential-free http/https URLs whose non-empty resolved IP set is entirely globally routable; it rejects localhost, loopback, private, link-local, multicast, reserved, unspecified or other non-global destinations. Approved hops are recorded in order.

Adapter-native return is not RA-2 truth. Its strict raw shape contains exactly: format, version, kind, invocation_fingerprint, request_fingerprint, adapter_ref, status, observations, failure, receipt. format/version/kind are exactly AIOS_ACQUISITION_ADAPTER_RETURN / 1 / ACQUISITION_ADAPTER_RETURN.

status is SUCCEEDED or FAILED. SUCCEEDED has failure=null and 0..request.max_items raw observations. FAILED has observations=[] and failure exactly {code}, where code is TOOL_UNAVAILABLE, ACCESS_DENIED, NOT_FOUND, RESPONSE_INVALID, ATTRIBUTION_MISMATCH or UNSAFE_DESTINATION.

A raw observation contains exactly representation_kind, provenance and content. content contains only text; adapter output never supplies content_sha256, instruction_trust, observation_fingerprint, Brief/request/source-family fields or any Research Record/claim/audit material. Deterministic RA-5 support supplies those exact RA-2 fields, computes content_sha256, fixes instruction_trust=UNTRUSTED and calls public construct_source_observation.

Raw receipt contains exactly native_operation_count, retry_count, pagination_count, query_expansion_count and fallback_count. All counts are non-negative integers; native_operation_count is at most 1 and is exactly 1 for SUCCEEDED. retry, pagination, query_expansion and fallback counts must always be 0.

PUBLIC_SEARCH successful observations may be only DISCOVERY_SNIPPET or SOURCE_METADATA. PUBLIC_HTTP and REPOSITORY_READ successful observations may be only SOURCE_CONTENT or SOURCE_METADATA. AUTHORIZED_CONNECTOR may use any existing RA-2 representation kind but all provenance access_scope values must be AUTHORIZED_PRIVATE. PUBLIC transports require PUBLIC provenance scope; REPOSITORY_READ provenance scope must equal invocation.access_mode.

For PUBLIC_HTTP success, at least one destination-guard hop must have been approved. The ordered approved URLs must exactly equal every returned observation provenance.resolution_chain and the final approved URL must equal each observation provenance.effective_locator. A guard rejection produces UNSAFE_DESTINATION and no source observation is constructed.

Deterministic RA-5 support constructs one exact RA-2 Acquisition Attempt from the normalized Source Observations or failure. adapter_id/adapter_version/invocation_id come only from the exact manifest/invocation and enter RA-2 Attempt attribution. They never enter Source Observation identity.

Adapter failure maps only to existing RA-2 operational reasons: TOOL_UNAVAILABLE -> ACQUISITION_UNAVAILABLE; ACCESS_DENIED or UNSAFE_DESTINATION -> ACQUISITION_ACCESS_DENIED; NOT_FOUND -> ACQUISITION_NOT_FOUND; RESPONSE_INVALID -> ACQUISITION_RESPONSE_INVALID; ATTRIBUTION_MISMATCH -> ACQUISITION_ATTRIBUTION_MISMATCH. Unsupported manifest/request/access combinations fail before adapter invocation and create no Acquisition Attempt.

Request/invocation/adapter-ref mismatch in adapter-native return is normalized only as ATTRIBUTION_MISMATCH; malformed native return after invocation is normalized only as RESPONSE_INVALID. Neither case triggers retry/fallback or semantic research closure.

Expose one transient content-addressed AIOS_ACQUISITION_ADAPTER_RESULT v1 containing exactly: format, version, kind, invocation_fingerprint, adapter_ref, adapter_failure_code, acquisition_attempt, receipt, destination_hops, result_fingerprint. destination_hops contains only guard-approved public HTTP hops as {url, resolved_ip_addresses}; it is empty for non-PUBLIC_HTTP transports. This result is operational cognitive support only and not lifecycle truth.

Adapter result normalized size is <=1048576 UTF-8 JSON bytes and structural depth <=24. Credentials, authorization_context_ref, native exception text, raw headers, cookies, provider/session identity and native tool logs are absent from normalized adapter result.

Existing RA-1/RA-2/RA-3/RA-4 contracts, Brain/Reviewer provider protocols, six existing Flow Cards, Brain Context/Resolver, Decision Packet, Unified State, Runtime, Reviewer, Publisher and authoring ingress behavior remain unchanged.

task.problem: RA-1 through RA-4 now define research intent, bounded acquisition identities, immutable Research Records and the exact two-pass research protocol, but they deliberately stop before provider/tool invocation. Without RA-5, a future integration could make the semantic provider depend on repository access, let provider/model/session metadata alter research identity, substitute Stage-2 research context, let source-family metadata choose a tool automatically, treat an adapter manifest as authorization, follow redirects to unsafe destinations, silently paginate/query-expand/retry/fallback, accept adapter-supplied fingerprints as truth, or let acquisition operational failure become research closure. RA-5 must freeze a portable invocation boundary while preserving Brain semantic authority and RA-2/RA-4 deterministic identities.
